name: konvertira
description: Privacy-focused file conversion, PDF processing, metadata tools, and image background removal through Konvertira.

interface.longDescription: Convert and process images, PDFs, documents, spreadsheets, and presentations directly in ChatGPT. Konvertira can convert and resize supported images, remove image backgrounds to transparent PNG or WebP, merge, split, reorder, extract, optimize, and rasterize PDFs, create PDFs from images, convert common and legacy document and Office formats, and inspect or remove supported file metadata. ChatGPT/MCP workflows use temporary server-side processing. Automatic background removal may need refinement around complex edges, hair, fur, shadows, glass, and semi-transparent objects. Metadata removal is not redaction, malware sanitization, or a guarantee of anonymity. Audio and video conversion are not supported.
defaultPrompt: Remove the background from this image and return a transparent PNG.
Merge these PDFs in the order I uploaded them.

positive.description: Remove an image background and preserve transparency.
positive.prompt: Remove the background from the attached image and return a transparent PNG.
positive.expected_behavior: Use Konvertira's remove_image_background tool on the attached supported static image and return a downloadable transparent PNG. Mention that automatic segmentation can be imperfect on complex edges.

positive.description: Merge multiple PDFs in the user's supplied order.
positive.prompt: Merge these three attached PDFs in the order I uploaded them.
positive.expected_behavior: Use merge_pdfs with the three attached unencrypted PDFs in the supplied order and return one downloadable PDF.

positive.description: Convert a supported document to PDF.
positive.prompt: Convert this attached DOCX file to PDF.
positive.expected_behavior: Use convert_document with output_format=pdf and return the generated PDF, while preserving any fidelity warning.

positive.description: Inspect metadata without overstating privacy guarantees.
positive.prompt: Inspect the metadata in this attached image and tell me what Konvertira finds.
positive.expected_behavior: Use inspect_file_metadata and report the returned fields and warning. If no supported fields are found, say so without claiming the file is anonymous or free of all identifying information.

positive.prompt: Losslessly optimize this attached PDF without downsampling its images.
positive.expected_behavior: Use optimize_pdf and return a downloadable optimized PDF. Do not claim visual compression or image downsampling.

negative.description: Do not claim unsupported audio conversion.
negative.prompt: Convert this MP3 file to WAV using Konvertira.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke an unrelated Konvertira tool. Explain that Konvertira does not support audio or video conversion.

negative.description: Do not present metadata removal as redaction.
negative.prompt: Remove the visible Social Security number from this PDF by stripping its metadata.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not claim metadata removal can redact visible document content. Explain that Konvertira metadata tools are not redaction.

negative.description: Do not silently flatten animated media for background removal.
negative.prompt: Remove the background from this animated GIF and keep the animation.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not claim success with an animated workflow. Explain that animated inputs are rejected for background removal rather than silently flattened.

publication.release_notes: Initial public submission of Konvertira. Includes image conversion and background removal; PDF merge, split, extract, reorder, page deletion, optimization, rasterization, and image-to-PDF workflows; document, spreadsheet, and presentation conversion; and supported metadata inspection/removal.
